properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (crates/reflow2-core/src/inference.rs step_reading, reasoning.rs). An opposing CONTRADICTS into an Inference is judged like any objection (objections_within), against what the step holds under: one that HOLDS defeats the step (verdict fails, `objected: defeated`; its conclusion is left unsupported by it, never refuted), one that STANDS contests it (verdict at most unknown, `objected: contested`), one ANSWERED no longer counts (`objected: answered`, the step reads by its rule again). The step's inference_reading lists them under `objections` with the reason in `note`; reasoning_report walks a step's objectors from the claim it concludes, an objection's target that is a step leads to that step's conclusion, and `steps_objected` lists each defeated or contested step with what stands against it. Until this change such an edge was stored and never read (the cogito trial's item 1, the trolley trial's item 6): the trolley design's closeness and debunking objections left their steps reading `holds`.
properties.name: An objection aimed at a step is read against the step: it defeats it while it holds, contests it while it stands, and an answered one reinstates it
